name: byd_bsd
description: BYD CR60 corner radar, Gen5 MF4 recordings: BSD/LCA warning + SIT relevantObjects + ego state

kappa.note: int16 NormalizedPerMetre0_125: kappa = raw * 0.125 / 32768 [1/m], positive = left (verify per project)

hmi.note: HMI level: 2 = warning shown; use --on-values 1,2 to include the pre-state

objects.note: dx/dy = front corner of the target in ego coordinates (not the centre). The behaviour instance is shared by both sides; the right side evaluates with dy inverted.

zone.note: BSD inner vertical line F = 0.5*min ego width + LyNear; replace with the value of the actual parameter set
